title: Verify Administrator can delete a parts return
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Invoicing & Payments: Delete, which gates deleting a return per spec v33 / SV-7911).
At least one parts return record exists under Parts > Returns.
steps:
1. Click Parts in the main navigation, then open the Returns section.
2. Open an existing return record.
3. Click Delete (or Delete Return) and confirm.
expected: The return is deleted and no longer appears in the Returns list.
